ABOUT NESTMATCH

Your housing search, organized.

Our free rental planning guides and cost comparison calculator can be used for housing searches anywhere in the United States, for short or long stays. They do not depend on local listing coverage.

NestMatch is a free, centralized rental discovery dashboard. Set preferences, swipe and save listings, compare costs, then follow the original listing to inquire or apply. Our first real source is Mi Casa Rentals in Pensacola, Florida. We do not yet cover every city or platform. Fictional Los Angeles samples remain available in a separate demo mode.

How ranking works

Known must-have mismatches are excluded. Remaining listings are ordered by matching preferences, then estimated monthly cost. Unknown costs and features are shown explicitly, and you can exclude them. Python and SQLite build the sample inventory; browser code applies preferences locally. Personal notes do not affect ranking.

The previous reciprocal-matching demo remains available with its local profile and photo controls. Its stored data has not been migrated or deleted.

What this demo is—and is not

Real listing facts come from Mi Casa Rentals’ public API, which permits republication with attribution. Source availability is not a guarantee of your whole stay; verify dates, photos, fees, and terms on the original site. NestMatch does not screen tenants, accept rent, or contact anyone. Preferences and decisions remain on your device.
